sources.title: New Relativistic Theory for Modified Newtonian Dynamics
sources.used_for: Original action, homogeneous background, fluid definitions and pressure nonclosure. Equations 5 and 7-13.
sources.boundary: Displayed cosmological vector equation has no nonzero constant F_Y contribution; this benchmark derives the lambda_s=1 term directly. Published observational fits are not assigned to this benchmark.

sources.title: Aether scalar tensor theory: Linear stability on Minkowski space

sources.boundary: The mode spectrum and threshold are reproduced checks, not new findings.

sources.title: Aether scalar tensor theory: Hamiltonian Formalism

sources.boundary: The finite-density quadratic expansion and response are author derivations checked by a separate Astra agent. See independent-review/REVIEW.md. No external peer review is claimed.
